caseName: National Can Corp. v. Washington Department of Revenue
caseNameFull: National Can Corp. v. Washington Department of Revenue and Tyler Pipe Industries, Inc. v. Washington Department of Revenue

opinions.text:
Appeals from Sup. Ct. Wash, dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeals were taken as petitions for writs of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Justice White, Justice Stevens, and Justice Scalia would note probable jurisdiction and set cases for oral argument.

Reported below: 109 Wash. 2d 878, 749 P. 2d 1286.
